eps.ov: While attempting to become a knight, Fia discovers a past she must hide at all costs.
The entrance exam will put Fia's cunning to the test and lead to significant encounters.
Fia joins the Sixth Unit on a monster hunt.

eps.t: The Fourth Monster Tamer Knight Brigade
eps.ov: Fia is assigned to the Fourth Brigade to offer her talents.
Fia meets Charlotte, a saint who needs a little boost to reach her potential.

eps.t: A Plan to Capture the Black King
eps.ov: Fia attends a meeting of captains. Meanwhile, Zavilia is hatching plans of his own.
Fia and the knights fight several high-ranking monsters.
Zavilia leaves to become the king of dragonkind.
Fia travels to Sutherland to help. Cyril needs her help with something only she can do.
